conditions.state: fresh simulator credential-save offer; decline does not sign out

transitions.action: iOS offers credential saving after normal sign-in
Decline using the iOS Not Now control
Confirm sign out; relaunch remains signed out
Confirm named session without backend write
Confirm quantity and notes into draft
Save draft through normal server route
Select all and clear the editable title
Select entire editable title with normal paragraph gesture
Backspace selected title and require entirely empty value
Save with one private pre-forward rejection
Remove fault and retry retained draft
Submit live specialty code through UI
Sign out/login coach and open pending queue
Sign out/login student; verify active assignment
Open scanner after camera permission reset
Deny using platform system permission control

pilotAssertions.startingState: Fresh owned Postgres fixture with a signed-out coach and completed onboarding
pilotAssertions.action: Sign in once with the seeded coach credentials through the rendered native UI
pilotAssertions.expected: The locked coach role/home is visible, exactly one native sign-in succeeds through the owned API, and the authenticated identity is bound to the same fixture coach

pilotAssertions.startingState: Successful native coach sign-in with the local bearer session persisted

pilotAssertions.startingState: Restored coach home with an active local native session
pilotAssertions.action: Open Account, open the sign-out confirmation, then cancel it
pilotAssertions.expected: The account screen and exact confirmation/cancel controls are visible and cancel leaves the session active

pilotAssertions.startingState: Active restored coach session with the sign-out confirmation closed after cancellation
pilotAssertions.action: Reopen the sign-out confirmation and confirm sign-out through the normal native UI once
pilotAssertions.expected: Sign-in is visible, local native session metadata is absent, authenticated native identity is cleared, and this native row does not claim server revocation

pilotAssertions.startingState: Confirmed local native sign-out with persisted session metadata absent
pilotAssertions.action: Terminate and relaunch the app without credentials
pilotAssertions.expected: Sign-in remains visible, no role/session is restored, and no authenticated hydrate follows the signed-out relaunch

pilotAssertions.startingState: Scoped domain SQL baseline captured before the session journey

pilotAssertions.expected: Complete owned profile and domain rows remain identical except the verified fixture coach updatedAt may advance only across separately bound sign-in POST 201 and restore hydrate POST 200 spans; after restoration all fields are strictly unchanged through logout/relaunch; auth-session records remain outside the declared domain-mutation scope

pilotAssertions.startingState: Fresh integration fixture with the unlinked mutation pair and a captured scoped SQL baseline.
pilotAssertions.action: Sign in normally as student and open relationships; sign in normally as coach and open home/pending/roster entry. Do not submit or confirm.
pilotAssertions.expected: The exact relationship/pending/roster controls are present, normal auth/read requests are forwarded, and the baseline snapshot is bound to this attempt without writes.

pilotAssertions.startingState: The exact student/coach pair is unlinked, has no same-pair pending or active connection, and the coach invite is active.
pilotAssertions.action: Acquire the invite code through the normal reviewed prerequisite, enter it in student.professionals.codeInput, and activate student.professionals.connectButton. Do not put the code in source or a public receipt.
pilotAssertions.expected: Exactly one connection for the intended student/coach/specialty is pending_confirmation; no duplicate, active conflict, or unrelated row changes occur; the pending UI and server response agree.

pilotAssertions.startingState: The submit row exists for the target pair with pending_confirmation and has not been confirmed.
pilotAssertions.action: Read relationships as the student, then switch through normal sign-out/sign-in to the coach and open the pending queue and roster.
pilotAssertions.expected: The exact pending identity appears in the coach queue and student pending view; pending guidance is present, the student has no End action, and no active row is shown.

pilotAssertions.startingState: The coach queue contains exactly one pending target produced by NAT-connection-submit-pending.
pilotAssertions.action: Activate the semantic confirmation control for the exact pending row; do not confirm a foreign or ambiguous row.
pilotAssertions.expected: The response and persisted row both become active exactly once; pending state is released; no duplicate or unrelated row changes occur.

pilotAssertions.startingState: The confirm response returned active for the target and the student can sign in normally.
pilotAssertions.action: Switch/sign in as the student and open relationships.
pilotAssertions.expected: The intended active relationship and End action are visible exactly once; no pending duplicate remains; GET /connections and active specialty/tracking records agree.

pilotAssertions.startingState: The target connection is active and the coach can sign in normally.
pilotAssertions.action: Open the coach roster and exit the pending view through semantic navigation.
pilotAssertions.expected: The roster contains the exact student once as active fitness_coach, the student is absent from pending, and UI/API/SQL identities agree.

pilotAssertions.startingState: Capture all scoped connection, invite, pending, access, specialty, and unrelated rows before submission.
pilotAssertions.action: Compare before, pending, active, and final snapshots while retaining the request history and exact target identity.
pilotAssertions.expected: Exactly one intended connection lifecycle and its expected auxiliary allocation/release/access rows change; no unrelated account, connection, invite, specialty, plan, or other fixture record changes.
